text: Why does it only work with s-planner and not with other agenda's like cozi. Very nice widget
author: Een Google-gebruiker
developer_reply:
Hello!
The application is designed to work with Google Calendar, "S-planner" is an application to work with Google Calendar.
Try Google Calendar official app (instead of "S-planner"): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.calendar
You can use it in conjunction with Sectograph.
